name: mcp-exposure-without-params
description: An exposure.list reply whose command entry has no params schema is rejected by the server when it builds the tools.
reason: Each command declaration holds its params schema (docs/spec/exposure.md#entry-fields, the params column of the entry table), so a page does not declare a command without one and the host does not give this reply. The case checks the rejection of a reply without the schema.
